accounting.note: All 100 listings have a preliminary power proposal (50 hybrid, 50 electric). The 14 facelift Sportage/Tucson HEV entries use 15.9 kW nominal continuous / 30-minute electric power, not the 47.7 kW peak. Reviewed open type-approval evidence and corrected four EV values where prior sources were weak or matched an older variant. No database write or publication.

method.hybrid: Parallel hybrids use ICE rated power plus matching hybrid-motor nominal continuous (30-minute proxy) power from open registration/homologation data. Manufacturer peak motor output is never substituted. Cross-market matches remain preliminary.
method.electric: Use explicit 30-minute electric power where available; where the exact local source card is absent, use matching manufacturer or open type-approval/vehicle-registry data by year, trim and drivetrain. Cross-market/version matches are preliminary and stated in each rationale; peak power is never substituted.

proposals.sourceTitle: Kia Sportage MY25 official HEV specifications + RDW Sportage 2025 type NQ5E/F5P61, nominal continuous motor power
proposals.sourceRationale: Official Kia MY25 HEV specifications identify the 1.6 T-GDi engine at 180 PS and electric motor peak at 47.7 kW. The matching 2025 RDW NQ5E/F5P61 registration lists electric nominal continuous power 15.90 kW. Customs estimate uses 180 PS ICE + 15.9 kW × 1.35962 = 201.62 PS; the peak motor rating is not added. Cross-market homologation family match; preliminary.

proposals.sourceTitle: RDW registry mirror: 2022 Hyundai Tucson HEV NX4E, 44.2 kW peak / 14.70 kW nominal continuous
proposals.sourceRationale: Open vehicle-register homologation data for the matching hybrid motor family lists 14.70 kW nominal continuous electric power (peak 44.2 kW). Official Hyundai/Kia specifications confirm this listing's matching engine size, hybrid generation and peak motor rating. Used ICE rated power plus the continuous electric rating; did not use peak/system output. Preliminary cross-market powertrain match.

proposals.sourceTitle: Hyundai Motor Group official facelift Tucson HEV specifications + Swiss type approval Tucson 1.6 T-GDI HEV, 30-minute motor power
proposals.sourceRationale: Hyundai Motor Group states facelift Tucson HEV uses the 1.6 T-GDi at 180 PS and 47.7 kW peak motor; Swiss type approval for Tucson 1.6 T-GDI HEV records 15.9 kW 30-minute power (47.7 kW peak).
